notes_for_editor: Thin. The only lookout-specific history is one 1936 item, reached secondhand through the Forest Lookouts index (the original newspaper was not checked). Searches (2) and page reads found nothing on build date, builder, design, staffing, fate or the site today. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Montana lists (firelookout.org Montana county page has no Boulder Baldy row). PeakVisor figures describe the peak, not the lookout station. Story is about 95 words, below the 120-word target. Editor to decide whether to publish or hold, as with the Clear Hills held file.
